title: Very small and flat due to packaging
text: Very small and flat due to packaging. Perfect for my needs but not as advertised. Very small and came flattened due to packaging. I was able to run my hands through it and fluff it out but it’s still lopsided. I’m not going to try to return this purchase but buyer beware.
